runs.command: .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pytest tests/test_target_concurrency.py tests/test_target_campaign.py tests/test_target_archive.py tests/test_steer_learning.py tests/test_online_storage.py tests/test_storage_lossless.py tests/test_generation_instrumentation.py tests/test_generation_batches.py tests/test_selection_scope.py -q --disable-warnings --maxfail=1

contracts: Four real processes claim one target exactly once with an empty running/finished marker
Two real controller processes enter different CPU fixture jobs simultaneously and merge 2+2 target archives without duplicate execution or lost state
Existing running, finished and error markers all skip; an all-marked queue starts no inference
A competing finished marker becomes error with the competition reason, complete traceback and child log
Incomplete archive groups are not flushed while another target is running
Published archive reservation recovers after interruption without regenerating candidates
Failed targets skip even with the old retry option; only explicit marker reset permits a new attempt
Legacy states migrate without inference; retained child failure logs are preserved
Unsafe marker keys are rejected; archives restore retained bytes and protect biological inputs
archive_unit: finished target jobs, default 10 targets per archive
limitations: A force-killed process leaves running occupied until explicit inspection/reset
Workers choose devices through their launch environment; no automatic GPU allocation
